path.description: FlashAttention-2 backward. run_flash_bwd always dispatches the seq-k-parallel kernel; every K/V column block of one (batch, head) accumulates its dQ partial into the fp32 dq_accum buffer with atomicAdd.

gate.note: With deterministic=True the grid in x shrinks to ceil(num_SMs / (b*h)) blocks and each block adds into its own dq_accum slice (blockIdx.x * dq_accum_split_stride); the slices are then summed in fixed order by convert_dQ. Within a block each thread owns distinct addresses, so the atomics are uncontended (A1) and the cross-block combine is sequential.

evidence.claim: atomicAdd(&tdQgdQaccum(i), acc_dq(i)) on the Seq_parallel path
dq_accum allocated as at::kFloat, so the operand is fp32
compute_dq_dk_dv_seqk_parallel loops n_block = blockIdx.x; n_block += gridDim.x, calling the 1colblock body with Seq_parallel=true
if params.deterministic, gridDimx = ceil(num_sm / (b*h)) instead of num_n_block
row_offset_dq_accum adds blockIdx.x * dq_accum_split_stride only when deterministic, giving each block a private slice
deterministic allocates dq_accum with a leading nsplits dimension
convert_dQ sums the nsplits slices in loop order s = 0..nsplits-1
deterministic=False is the default at every public entry point

notes: Non-deterministic on the default path (deterministic=False). The gated path is deterministic: uncontended atomics plus a fixed-order reduce kernel. Training only; no inference engine in this census calls the FA2 backward.

gate.note: When Deterministic, Barrier::wait_eq on dq_semaphore[m_block, b, h] makes the n_block-th contributor wait for the previous n_block-1 contributors and arrive_inc after its reduce, so the reduce-adds into each dQ tile happen in n_block order (A2).

SM90_BULK_REDUCE_ADD is cp.reduce.async.bulk.global.shared::cta.bulk_group.add.f32

Barrier::arrive_inc after the reduce under if constexpr (Deterministic)

deterministic: bool = False default

path.description: FlashAttention-3 forward and backward persistent schedulers hand out the next tile index with an integer ticket counter (tile_count_semaphore). Also VarlenDynamicPersistentTileScheduler::prefetch_next_work at line 786.

evidence.claim: atomicAdd(params.tile_count_semaphore, 1) returns the next tile id
same pattern in the varlen scheduler

the split-KV combine kernel sums the scaled partial LSEs in loop order s = 0..num_splits-1 in a separate kernel; the scanner found no atomics in any hopper/*fwd* or combine file, so tile-to-CTA assignment does not change any float reduction order

notes: Exact integer counter. Tile-to-CTA assignment does not feed a float reduction: each tile's output is written once (forward) or serialised or already class A (backward), so not B-indirect.

path.description: FlashAttention-3 varlen forward: a block-wide integer sum of the number of tiles, used to pick a dynamic split count.

evidence.claim: atomicAdd(total_blocks_smem, total_blocks) on a __shared__ int, one add per warp

notes: Exact integer sum. The resulting num_splits_dynamic changes how many KV splits the forward uses, and therefore the split-KV combine order, but the sum is order-invariant so the same inputs give the same split count. Not B-indirect.
